scanNote:
15-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (106-bet) - KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQLAR.

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliqda oq '15' va 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Reported Instructions'.
7) 'Study the rule and the examples, then say how reported instructions differ from reported questions.' KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Reported Instructions': 'To report instructions we use: ask/tell + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive'. JADVAL (yigit surati, pufaklar): Direct Speech: 'CHECK the manual, please.' → Reported Speech: 'He asked me TO CHECK the manual.' 'DON'T TOUCH the wire, please.' → 'He told me NOT TO TOUCH the wire.'
8) Qiya: 'Last Monday Jeff had his fifth lesson on how to use the Internet.' 'His instructor gave him some tips. Put the tips into reported speech.' (Instruktor surati, pufaklar): 1 Be polite and informative. 2 Look at lists of FAQs. 3 Get to know how the system works. 4 Do not use capital letters inappropriately. 5 Do not send inappropriate e-mail. 6 Don't give personal information to 'chat friends'. Chiziqlar 1-6.

O'NG USTUN:
9) 'Rewrite the sentences in reported speech, as in the example.' 1 "Who sent the e-mail message?" Sally asked John. Ko'k qiya: 'Sally asked John who had sent the e-mail message.' 2 "He has called twice," she said. 3 "Where does he live?" Sue asked. 4 "I'll see you on Monday," Bob said to Lyn. 5 "He missed the bus," Claire said. 6 "I can't help you," Karen said to Mary.
10) 'Read the e-mail message and answer the questions. Then, turn the reported instructions into direct speech.' E-MAIL OYNASI: To: Frank@notor.co.uk; Subject: Tom Billings-new offices. 'Dear Frank, Just a quick note to check that I gave Tom Billings the correct instructions concerning the new offices. I told him to make sure there are phone lines in each office. I asked him to order computers for all the offices. I also told him to finish the decorating by next week. Hope I didn't forget anything. Karen Briggs' 1 Who sent the message? 2 What is it about? 3 Are the layout and style the same as for a letter?
• To'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Phil Crawley gave Janet Black these instructions.' Pufaklar: 'Collect all the documents and leave them with the receptionist.' 'Don't send the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet.' 'Call Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday.' 'Now he is sending an e-mail to Kim Phelps to check that the instructions were correct. Complete his message to Kim in the Photo File section.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '106'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the rule and the examples, then say how reported instructions differ from reported questions. To report instructions we use: ask/tell + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive. "Check the manual, please." → He asked me to check the manual. "Don't touch the wire, please." → He told me not to touch the wire.
exercises.instructionUz: Qoida va misollarni o'rganing, keyin ko'chirma buyruqlar ko'chirma savollardan qanday farq qilishini ayting. Buyruqlarni ko'chirish uchun: ask/tell + to'ldiruvchi + (not) + to-infinitiv. "Qo'llanmani tekshiring, iltimos." → U mendan qo'llanmani tekshirishni so'radi. "Simga tegmang, iltimos." → U menga simga tegmaslikni aytdi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOLIP                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask/tell + KIM + (not) + TO +
  FE'L

  'Check the manual.' →
  'He asked me TO CHECK the
   manual.'
  "Don't touch the wire." →
  'He told me NOT TO TOUCH the
   wire.'

  ⚠ INKOR: 'NOT TO' - 'to not'
  EMAS!
  ⚠ 'please' tushiriladi.
  ⚠ ask = iltimos (muloyim);
  tell = buyruq (qat'iy).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAVOLDAN FARQI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'ChIRMA SAVOL:
    ask + wh-/if + EGA + FE'L
    (zamon orqaga)
    'She asked me where I LIVED.'

  KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ:
    ask/tell + KIM + TO + FE'L
    (infinitiv - zamon YO'Q!)
    'She told me TO GO home.'

  ⚠ Buyruqda zamon o'zgarmaydi -
  infinitiv ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A MANUAL':

  = qo'llanma.


⚠ 'A WIRE':

  = sim.


⚠ 'A DIRECT OBJECT':

  = to'ldiruvchi (me, him, us).

points.en: To report instructions we use: ask/tell + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive.
points.uz: Buyruqlarni ko'chirish uchun: ask/tell + to'ldiruvchi + (not) + to-infinitiv.
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'asked me TO check', 'told me NOT TO touch'.

points.en: "Check the manual, please." → He asked me to check the manual.
points.uz: "Qo'llanmani tekshiring, iltimos." → U mendan qo'llanmani tekshirishni so'radi.

points.en: "Don't touch the wire, please." → He told me not to touch the wire.
points.uz: "Simga tegmang, iltimos." → U menga simga tegmaslikni aytdi.

points.en: Difference: reported questions use ask + wh-/if + subject + verb (tense changes); reported instructions use ask/tell + object + (not) to-infinitive (no tense change).
points.uz: Farqi: ko'chirma savollarda ask + wh-/if + ega + fe'l (zamon o'zgaradi); ko'chirma buyruqlarda ask/tell + to'ldiruvchi + (not) to-infinitiv (zamon o'zgarmaydi).

exercises.instructionEn: Last Monday Jeff had his fifth lesson on how to use the Internet. His instructor gave him some tips. Put the tips into reported speech. 1 Be polite and informative. 2 Look at lists of FAQs. 3 Get to know how the system works. 4 Do not use capital letters inappropriately. 5 Do not send inappropriate e-mail. 6 Don't give personal information to 'chat friends'.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan dushanba Jeff Internetdan foydalanish bo'yicha beshinchi darsini o'tdi. Instruktori unga bir nechta maslahat berdi. Maslahatlarni ko'chirma gapga o'tkazing. 1 Xushmuomala va ma'lumotli bo'ling. 2 FAQ ro'yxatlariga qarang. 3 Tizim qanday ishlashini bilib oling. 4 Bosh harflarni noo'rin ishlatmang. 5 Noo'rin e-mail yubormang. 6 'Chat do'stlari'ga shaxsiy ma'lumot bermang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 The instructor told Jeff TO BE
    polite and informative.
  2 He told him TO LOOK at lists
    of FAQs.
  3 He told him TO GET to know how
    the system works.
  4 He told him NOT TO USE capital
    letters inappropriately.
  5 He told him NOT TO SEND
    inappropriate e-mail.
  6 He told him NOT TO GIVE
    personal information to 'chat
    friends'.

  ⚠ 'asked' ham mumkin (maslahat).


⚠ 'A TIP':

  = maslahat.


⚠ 'INFORMATIVE':

  = ma'lumotli, foydali.


⚠ 'CAPITAL LETTERS':

  = bosh harflar.
  ⚠ Internetda BOSh HARFLAR =
  baqirish!


⚠ 'INAPPROPRIATELY':

  = noo'rin.
  ⚠ 'appropriate' = o'rinli.


⚠ 'TO GET TO KNOW':

  = bilib olmoq, tanishmoq.

items.textEn: 1 "Be polite and informative." → The instructor told Jeff ___.
2 "Look at lists of FAQs." → He told him ___.
items.answer: to look at lists of FAQs

items.textEn: 3 "Get to know how the system works." → He told him ___.
items.answer: to get to know how the system works

items.textEn: 4 "Do not use capital letters inappropriately." → He told him ___.
items.answer: not to use capital letters inappropriately

items.textEn: 5 "Do not send inappropriate e-mail." → He told him ___.
6 "Don't give personal information to 'chat friends'." → He told him ___.
items.answer: not to give personal information to 'chat friends'

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in reported speech, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ko'chirma gapda qayta yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "Who sent the e-mail message?"
  Sally asked John.
  → Sally asked John who had sent
    the e-mail message.


JAVOBLAR (aralash - darak, savol):

  2 She said (that) he HAD CALLED
    twice. (has called → had
    called)
  3 Sue asked where he LIVED.
    (does he live → he lived)
  4 Bob told Lyn (that) he WOULD
    see her on Monday. (I'll → he
    would; you → her)
  5 Claire said (that) he HAD
    MISSED the bus. (missed → had
    missed)
  6 Karen told Mary (that) she
    COULDN'T help her. (can't →
    couldn't; you → her)


⚠ 1 - 'who sent' → 'who HAD SENT'
(past simple → past perfect).
⚠ 'who' - ega bo'lganda tartib
o'zgarmaydi.


⚠ 'TWICE':

  = ikki marta.


⚠ 'TO MISS THE BUS':

  = avtobusga kech qolmoq.

items.textEn: 1 "Who sent the e-mail message?" Sally asked John. → Sally asked John ___.
items.answer: who had sent the e-mail message

items.textEn: 2 "He has called twice," she said. → She said (that) ___.
3 "Where does he live?" Sue asked. → Sue asked ___.
4 "I'll see you on Monday," Bob said to Lyn. → Bob told Lyn (that) ___.
items.answer: he would see her on Monday

items.textEn: 5 "He missed the bus," Claire said. → Claire said (that) ___.
6 "I can't help you," Karen said to Mary. → Karen told Mary (that) ___.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the e-mail message and answer the questions. "Dear Frank, Just a quick note to check that I gave Tom Billings the correct instructions concerning the new offices. I told him to make sure there are phone lines in each office. I asked him to order computers for all the offices. I also told him to finish the decorating by next week. Hope I didn't forget anything. Karen Briggs" 1 Who sent the message? 2 What is it about? 3 Are the layout and style the same as for a letter?
exercises.instructionUz: E-mail xabarini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. "Aziz Frank, Tom Billingsga yangi ofislar bo'yicha to'g'ri ko'rsatmalar berganimni tekshirish uchun qisqa xat. Men unga har ofisda telefon liniyalari borligiga ishonch hosil qilishni aytdim. Undan barcha ofislar uchun kompyuter buyurtma qilishni so'radim. Unga ta'mirlashni kelasi haftagacha tugatishni ham aytdim. Hech narsani unutmagan bo'lsam kerak. Karen Briggs" 1 Xabarni kim yubordi? 2 U nima haqida? 3 Tartib va uslub xatniki bilan bir xilmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 Karen Briggs
  2 Tom Billingsga yangi ofislar
    bo'yicha berilgan ko'rsatmalar
  3 Yo'q - e-mail qisqaroq va
    norasmiyroq: manzil va sana
    yo'q, 'Just a quick note',
    'Hope I didn't forget' (ega
    tushirilgan).


⚠ 'A QUICK NOTE':

  = qisqa xat.


⚠ 'CONCERNING':

  = ... bo'yicha, ... haqida.


⚠ 'TO MAKE SURE':

  = ishonch hosil qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO ORDER':

  = buyurtma qilmoq.


⚠ 'BY NEXT WEEK':

  = kelasi haftagacha.


⚠ 'LAYOUT':

  = tartib, joylashuv.

items.answerEn: Karen Briggs sent it to Frank.
It is about the instructions Karen gave Tom Billings concerning the new offices.
items.answerUz: U Karen Tom Billingsga yangi ofislar bo'yicha bergan ko'rsatmalar haqida.

items.en: 3 Are the layout and style the same as for a letter?
items.uz: 3 Tartib va uslub xatniki bilan bir xilmi?
items.answerEn: No. An e-mail is shorter and less formal: there is no address or date, and the style is informal ('Just a quick note', 'Hope I didn't forget anything').
items.answerUz: Yo'q. E-mail qisqaroq va kamroq rasmiy: manzil va sana yo'q, uslub norasmiy ('Just a quick note', 'Hope I didn't forget anything').

exercises.instructionEn: Turn the reported instructions into direct speech.
exercises.explanationUz:
TESKARI YO'NALISh - ko'chirmadan
to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapga:

  'I told him to make sure ...' →
  "Make sure there are phone lines
   in each office."
  'I asked him to order ...' →
  "Order computers for all the
   offices, please." ('asked' →
   'please')
  'I told him to finish ...' →
  "Finish the decorating by next
   week."

  ⚠ 'to' tushiriladi, buyruq shakli.

items.textEn: 1 I told him to make sure there are phone lines in each office. → "___"
items.answer: Make sure there are phone lines in each office.

items.textEn: 2 I asked him to order computers for all the offices. → "___"
items.answer: Order computers for all the offices, please.

items.textEn: 3 I also told him to finish the decorating by next week. → "___"
items.answer: Finish the decorating by next week.

exercises.instructionEn: Phil Crawley gave Janet Black these instructions: "Collect all the documents and leave them with the receptionist." "Don't send the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet." "Call Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday." Now he is sending an e-mail to Kim Phelps to check that the instructions were correct. Complete his message to Kim in the Photo File section.
exercises.instructionUz: Phil Crawley Janet Blackka bu ko'rsatmalarni berdi: "Barcha hujjatlarni yig'ing va qabulxona xodimiga qoldiring." "Chekni hali Crown Street ofisiga yubormang." "Kelasi juma uchrashuv belgilash uchun janob Robsonga qo'ng'iroq qiling." Endi u ko'rsatmalar to'g'ri ekanini tekshirish uchun Kim Phelpsga e-mail yubormoqda. Uning Kimga xabarini Photo File bo'limida to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 10-mashqdagi e-mail qolipida.
⚠ Ko'chirma buyruqlar:
  told her TO collect ...
  told her NOT TO send ...
  asked her TO call ...


⚠ 'A CHEQUE':

  = chek (bank). /tʃek/.


⚠ 'YET':

  = hali (inkorda).
